title: Coconut Curry Chicken Recipe
reject_reason: Generic diced-chicken coconut-milk curry (curry powder + tomato) over rice is the coconut-chicken-curry archetype already carried by live kuku-paka and chicken-madras; no distinct regional identity to justify a second coconut chicken curry.
